paragraphs.text: Survivor is a rarely used creature type , depicting people remaining alive after an event in which others have died. It first appeared on tokens in Alliances .
From its introduction until Duskmourn: House of Horror the type only appeared on tokens related to General Varchild of Kjeldor . First in Alliances , and later in Commander 2018 .
The creature type finally appeared on nontoken cards in Duskmourn: House of Horror , where it was used for creators with the Survival mechanic.
During the Ice Age of Dominaria , the traitorous General Varchild of Kjeldor performed countless raids on Balduvia which only left a handful of Survivors.
On Duskmourn , the Survivors are all those who have not been converted or killed by the House yet.
